soft_deny: git commit with --no-verify, or any attempt to bypass the mandatory pre-commit hook (project rule 05-harness forbids it unless the user explicitly requests --no-verify)

any write, commit, checkout, stash, or branch operation inside the reference repositories (claude_managed_agents, hassan-v2-backend, hassan-v2-frontend) — they are read-only sources of truth for this design repository
git push --force / --force-with-lease, git reset --hard, or git clean -fd that discards uncommitted work

deleting or wholesale-rewriting existing design artifacts under docs/design/, docs/analysis/, or aidlc-docs/ (design decisions are the product of this repository; supersede them with a new revision instead)

outward-facing or repository-level operations: creating/editing/merging/closing pull requests or issues, creating/deleting/editing repositories, changing auth (gh pr / gh issue / gh repo / gh auth), or pushing branches to a remote

executing arbitrary code through an interpreter whose runtime behavior is not visible in the command itself (python3 -c or a script file, node -e, go run, or bash/sh running an ad-hoc script), since it can read or transmit secrets or mutate state outside the reviewed doc-lint/traceability commands
running builds, servers, database commands, or docker containers from this repository — it contains no product code, so such a command is operating on some other repository
hard_deny: reading, printing (cat/echo/grep), or transmitting the contents of .env or other secret/credential files, including those inside the reference repositories
